description: This file contains the utility class StringUtil, which provides static methods for masking string values, likely used for obscuring sensitive data in the system.

classes.name: StringUtil
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for masking string values, such as masking sensitive information.

methods.name: maskValue
methods.description: Masks a string value, displaying only the unmaskedLength of characters at the end, replacing the rest with asterisks. Defaults to unmaskedLength of 4.

methods.name: maskValue
methods.description: Overloaded method allowing customization of the number of unmasked characters.
